title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
english: German authorities have officially blamed Russia for a recent failed drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport, citing clear intelligence evidence of sabotage. In retaliation, Germany is shutting down a Russian consulate and terminating the contract for the Russian House in Berlin over concerns regarding espionage. Russia has denied these allegations and vowed to retaliate against Germany's decision to tighten security and diplomatic restrictions.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት በቅርቡ በ ላይፕዚግ/ሃሌ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ለተፈጸመው ያልተሳካ የድሮን ጥቃት ሩሲያ ተጠያቂ መሆኗን በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። ለዚህም ምላሽ ጀርመን የስለላ ስራዎችን በመስራት ተጠርጥረው የነበሩ የሩሲያ ተቋማትን በመዝጋት በሩሲያ ዲፕሎማቶች ላይ የጉዞ ገደቦችን ጥላለች። ሩሲያ ክሱን ውድቅ ያደረገች ሲሆን በጀርመን እርምጃ ላይ ተመሳሳይ የመልስ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስፈራርታለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Jarman miidhaa qilleensa irraa gara buufata xiyyaaraa Leipzig/Halletti qaqqabeef Itoophiyaa osoo hin taane, Ruusiyaan itti gaafatamtuu akka taate mirkaneesseera. Jarman tarkaanfii kanaan walqabatee bakka bu'oota Ruusiyaa fi dhaabbata 'Russian House' jedhamu kan biyyattii keessatti socho'aa ture cufuuf murteessiteetti. Ruusiyaan himannaa kana kan haalte yoo ta'u, Jarman irratti haaloo bahuuf akka kaatte ibsiteetti.

title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
english: A hydropower worker in Nepal narrowly escaped a tunnel after sudden, deadly flash floods from the Trishuli River caused a catastrophic collapse. As he fled the rising waters for twenty minutes, he discovered that the disaster had destroyed his home and claimed the lives of several family members. Rescue operations remain ongoing at various tunnel sites, where hundreds of laborers are still missing following the floods that have resulted in over 1,000 deaths across the country.

oromo: Hojjetaan projekti hidha bishaan irraa humna ibsaa maddisiisuu tokko Nepaal keessatti, lolaa tasaa laga Trishuli irraa ka’eefi gara holqa hojii isaa seenen lubbuun hafe. Namichi kun bishaan lolaa isaa duukaa bu’e jalaa daqiiqaa 20f yeroo dheeratu, mana isaa diigameefi maatiin isaa irraa du’an arguun gadda guddaaf saaxilame. Balaa kana keessatti namoonni 1,000 ol du'aniiru; hojjettoonni hedduunis holqa keessatti dhabamanii, waraanni fi ogeeyyiin dhimmi isaa ilaallatu barbaacha itti fufanii jiru.

title: Vance calls Michigan Senate candidate El-Sayed 'evil' at campaign rally
english: US Vice-President JD Vance publicly attacked Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed at a rally, labeling him an evil and divisive figure. The conflict intensified after El-Sayed allegedly questioned how Vance's family would perceive his wife's background, prompting a sharp rebuke from Vance. In response, El-Sayed defended himself by characterizing the Trump administration's political agenda as harmful and morally wrong.

oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance walgahii filannoo irratti, kaadhimamaa seenaatii kan Michigan Abdul El-Sayed nama hamaa fi biyya diigudha jechuun ceephataniiru. Walitti buutiin kun kan dhalate erga El-Sayed maatiin Vance waa'ee haadha manaa isaanii ilaalcha akkamii qabu jechuun gaaffii kaasee booda. Vance gaaffii kanaaf deebii cimaa kenneen booda, El-Sayed ammoo siyaasni bulchiinsa Trump miidhaa geessisaa fi naamusa kan hin qabne jechuun deebiseef.

title: Pitso Mosimane appointed by South Africa ahead of AFCON qualifiers
english: Pitso Mosimane has been named the new head coach of the South Africa national football team, taking over from Hugo Broos. The veteran manager, who is highly decorated at the club level, has been signed to lead the team through the 2030 World Cup. He now faces the urgent task of preparing the squad for their upcoming 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying match against Guinea.
amharic: ፒትሶ ሞሲማኔ ከሁጎ ብሩስ በመረከብ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ብሄራዊ ቡድን ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ተሾመዋል። በክለብ ደረጃ ትልቅ ስኬት ያስመዘገቡት የ62 አመቱ አሰልጣኝ፣ እስከ 2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ድረስ ቡድኑን እንዲመሩ ውል ተፈራርመዋል። አሰልጣኙ በአሁኑ ወቅት የ2027 የአፍሪካ ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታቸውን ከጊኒ ጋር የሚያደርጉበትን ቡድን የማዘጋጀት ፈታኝ ተግባር ይጠብቃቸዋል።
oromo: Pitson Mosimaane leenjisaa garee kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessa Afrikaa Kibbaa ta'uun Hugo Broos bakka bu'eera. Leenjisaan muuxannoo qaban kun, hanga waancaa addunyaa bara 2030tti garee kana akka hoogganan waliigalteerrä gahuun beekameera. Amma garuu qophiin yeroo gabaabaa keessatti xumuramee tapha calallii waancaa Afrikaa bara 2027 kan Ginii waliin ta'uuf xiyyeeffannaa kennuun irra jiraata.

title: China’s Xi makes first visit to Egypt in a decade, amid regional turmoil
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping has arrived in Cairo for his first visit in ten years to celebrate 70 years of diplomatic relations with Egypt. The two leaders aim to strengthen their strategic partnership and discuss international issues during this time of regional instability. Furthermore, the visit highlights growing economic ties, with China serving as a major investor and trading partner for Egypt, particularly in the Suez Canal zone.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዚዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ ከግብፅ ጋር ያላቸውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት 70ኛ ዓመት ለማክበር በአስር ዓመት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ካይሮ ተጉዘዋል። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በክልሉ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ወቅት ስልታዊ አጋርነታቸውን ለማጠናከር እና በጋራ ጉዳዮች ላይ ለመወያየት አቅደዋል። ጉብኝቱም በተለይም በሱዌዝ ካናል ቀጠና ውስጥ የቻይና ኢንቨስትመንትና የሁለቱን አገራት የንግድ ግንኙነት ይበልጥ ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jinpiing waggaa 70ffaa hariiroo diippiloomaasii Gibxii waliin qaban kabajuuf gara Kaayiroo imalaniiru. Hogganoonni lameen kun yeroo ammaa naannichatti rakkoolee uumaman jiran irratti mari'achuufi walitti dhufeenya guddina biyyoota isaanii cimsuuf kaayyeffataniiru. Imalli kun hariiroo daldalaafi invastimantii cimaa biyyoonni kunneen qaban, keessattuu naannoo daandii galaana Suweez irratti babal'isuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Ousted UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer to quit domestic politics
english: Former UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer has announced his resignation as a member of parliament after serving for 11 years. Following his departure from the premiership earlier this summer due to declining political support, he intends to shift his focus toward global issues like international security and trade. This decision will trigger a by-election to fill his vacant seat in London.

oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii UK Keir Starmer waggoota 11 booda miseensummaa paarlaamaa gadhiisuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Waggoota muraasa dura deeggarsa siyaasaa dhabuun muummicha ministeerummaarraa erga bu'anii booda, amma xiyyeeffannoo isaanii dhimmoota addunyaa kan akka nageenyaa fi daldalaa irratti gochuuf murteessaniiru. Murteen kun bakka isaanii bakka buusuuf filannoo biroo akka gaggeeffamu taasisa.

title: US launches new strikes against Iran as war escalates
english: The United States military conducted major strikes against the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps following threats to American troops and regional shipping. Iran has vowed to retaliate, despite warnings from President Trump that any counterattack would result in even more severe military consequences. The U.S. government has also advised its citizens in the Middle East to remain vigilant due to the heightened risk of conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች እና በመርከቦች ላይ የተቃጡ ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ኢራን ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ ቃል ብትገባም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢራን የበቀል እርምጃ ከባድ አጸፋ እንደሚያስከትል አስጠንቅቀዋል። አሜሪካ በበኩሏ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚገኙ ዜጎቿ የጸጥታ ስጋት ሊኖር ስለሚችል ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Humnooti waraana Ameerikaa loltoota isaanii fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti miidhaan erga qaqqabee booda, garee 'Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' (IRGC) jedhamu irratti haleellaa cimaa raawwataniiru. Itoophiyaan keessattuu namoonni mootummaan Itoophiyaa irraa deebii kennuuf waadaa seenanillee, pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraampii yoo deebii kennan haleellaa kana caalu akka mudatu akeekkachiisaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa lammiileen isaa naannoo Baha Giddugaleessaa keessa jiran, balaa waraanaa kanarraa kan ka'e akka of eeggannoo cimaa godhatan akeekkachiiseera.

title: IAEA reports progress in Syria investigation, none in Iran
english: The UN nuclear watchdog has successfully closed its investigation into Syria's historical secret nuclear program. In contrast, the agency reported no progress regarding Iran, noting that it still lacks the necessary access to monitor uranium levels. This ongoing lack of transparency in Iran continues to be a major source of concern for nuclear proliferation.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኒውክሌር ተቆጣጣሪ ኤጀንሲ በሶሪያ የቀድሞ የኒውክሌር እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ ሲያደርግ የነበረውን ምርመራ በስኬት ማጠናቀቁን አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል በኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ላይ ምንም አይነት መሻሻል አለመኖሩን እና የዩራኒየም ክምችትን ለመቆጣጠር በቂ መዳረሻ እንደሌላቸው ገልጿል። ይህ በኢራን በኩል ያለው የመረጃ ግልጽነት ማጣት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mootummoota gamtoomaniifila hordoffii niwukilaraa, qorannoo waggoota darban Itoophiyaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa ture xumuruu isaa beeksisera. Gama biraatiin, Iran keessatti guddinni tokkollee akka hin jirre fi hanga yuraaniyamiis hordofuu akka hin dandeenye ibsameera. Haala Iran keessatti mul'atu kanaan, sodaan faca'iina meeshaalee niwukilaraa akka itti fufe jira.

title: IRGC say US will 'regret' renewed attacks
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has threatened retaliation against the United States following recent strikes near the Strait of Hormuz. Despite warnings from the American leadership, Iranian officials claimed they are planning a significantly larger counter-attack against regional U.S. interests. This escalation heightens tensions as both nations trade warnings regarding future military actions.

oromo: Humni Eegumsa Islaamummaa Iraan (IRGC) weerara Yunaayitid Isteetsi daangaa Hormuzitti raawwatte hordofee haaloo akka baasu dhaadate. Hogganoonni Iraan akeekkachiisa mootummaa Ameerikaa irraa kennameefis osoo hin harka kennatin, buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa kan naannichatti argaman irratti weerara hammaataa ta'e akka raawwatan dubbataniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran kan hammaachiseedha.

title: Trump warns of 'much harder' action if Iran retaliates after strikes
english: Former President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning to Iran, stating that any retaliation for recent U.S. airstrikes will result in even more severe military consequences. These initial American attacks were launched in response to Iranian involvement in attacks against a U.S. base in Jordan. Trump cautioned that further escalation could lead to devastating damage to the nation of Iran.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ በተፈጸሙ የአየር ጥቃቶች ላይ በቀል የምትወስድ ከሆነ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚጠብቃት አስጠንቅቀዋል። እነዚህ የአሜሪካ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ቤዝ ላይ ለተፈጸመው ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። ትራምፕ አክለውም ኢራን ተጨማሪ ጥቃት ብትሰነዝር ሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ጥፋት እንደሚገጥማት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidantii duraanii Doonald Traamp, Iraan weerara qilleensaarraa kan Ameerikaan gaggeessiteef deebii yoo kennite, tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa ta'een akka adabamtu akeekkachiisaniiru. Weerari Ameerikaa kun kan raawwatame buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Yordaanos keessa jiru irratti miidhaan erga ga'ee booda ture. Traamp itti dabaluun, Iraan weerara kana caalaatti itti fufte, biyyi sun miidhaa hamaa akka keessummeessitu ibsaniiru.

title: US army secretary resigns amid signs of Pentagon unease with Iran war
english: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned following internal disagreements with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth regarding the ongoing war with Iran. Military leaders have expressed concern that prolonged operations are depleting critical weapons stockpiles and undermining the nation's readiness to address other global threats. This departure highlights growing friction within the administration over war strategy and the sustainability of current military commitments.

oromo: Ministirri Waraana Ameerikaa Dan Dristkol, waraana Iran wajjin jiru ilaalchisee ministira ittisaa Pit Hegseth waliin wal-dhabdee uumameen booda aangoo gadhiiseera. Hogganoonni waraanaa, waraanni kun dheerachuu isaan, meeshaalee waraanaa barbaachisoo ta'an akka dhumanii fi dandeettii biyyattii kan biroo ittisuuf qabdu akka laaffisu yaadda'anii jiru. Gadi-lhiisuun kun, mootummaan waraana Iran irratti tarkaanfii fudhatu irratti fi qophii waraanaa irratti wal-dhabdee keessa jiraachuu isaa ifa godha.

title: US State Department issues security alert for citizens in Middle East
english: The US State Department has issued a safety warning for American citizens throughout the Middle East due to rising regional instability. Travelers are advised to stay alert as military actions, including recent strikes against Iran, could lead to sudden flight cancellations or airspace restrictions. Authorities emphasized that the security situation is volatile and could escalate unexpectedly.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መሥሪያ ቤት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው የጸጥታ መደፍረስ ምክንያት በዚያ ለሚገኙ ዜጎቹ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥቷል። በኢራን ላይ የተወሰዱትን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ተከትሎ በረራዎች ሊሰረዙና የአየር ክልል ሊዘጋ ስለሚችል ተጓዦች ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ተመክሯል። ወቅታዊው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ አደገኛ እና በማንኛውም ሰዓት ሊባባስ እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessatti sodaa nageenyaa uumame hordofee lammiilee isaa achi jiranuf akeekkachiisa baaseera. Tarkaanfiin waraanaa Iran irratti fudhatame dhiibbaa uumuu danda'uuf, balalliiwwan xiyyaaraa fi cufiinsi qilleensa irraa waan mul'achuu danda'uuf namoonni of eeggannoo cimaa akka taasisan gorfamaniiru. Haalli nageenyaa naannichaa tasgabbii kan hin qabne fi yeroo kamiyyuu kan hammaachuu danda'u ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
english: Spanish prosecutors report that sexual assaults, including those involving minors, have become a daily occurrence in the enclave of Ceuta following a massive surge of migrants. Authorities believe the actual number of incidents is likely higher, as many victims are afraid to report these crimes due to their precarious legal status. In response, the government is providing emergency aid to support vulnerable migrants while facing significant political pressure to resolve the ongoing border crisis.
amharic: በሴኡታ ግዛት ውስጥ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች መጉረፍ ሳቢያ፣ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በየቀኑ የጾታዊ ጥቃት ድርጊቶች እየተፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን የስፔን አቃቤ ህጎች አስታውቀዋል። ብዙዎቹ ተጎጂዎች በህገ-ወጥ የኑሮ ሁኔታቸው ምክንያት ፍርሃት ስላደረባቸው ድርጊቱን ለፖሊስ እንደማያሳውቁና ይህም የተመዘገበውን ቁጥር ከፍ ሊያደርገው እንደሚችል ተገልጿል። መንግስት ለችግሩ መፍትሄ ለመስጠት ድንገተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ በአስቸጋሪው የድንበር ቀውስ ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ተቃውሞ እየገጠመው ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ispeen akka ibsetti, godaantota Ceuta gahan keessatti miidhaan saalaa, kanneen ijoollee dabalatu, guyyaa guyyaan raawwatamaa jiraachuu beekameera. Godaantonni hedduun haala seeraan alaa waan jiraniif, sodaa irraa kan ka'e yakka kana gabaasuu akka hin dandeenyeefi lakkoofsi dhugaa isaa kana caaluu akka danda'u himameera. Mootummaan rakkoo kana furuuf gargaarsa ariifataa godhaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, dhimma daangaa kana ilaalchisee mormii cimaa siyaasaa keessa galeera.

title: Israel says senior Hamas member seized as strikes kill three during Gaza raid
english: Israeli defense officials confirmed the capture of a high-ranking Hamas operative following a specialized military operation in Gaza City. The raid triggered intense aerial bombardment, which local health officials report resulted in the deaths of three civilians, including two children. While Israel maintains that its forces are actively targeting Hamas leadership and infrastructure, Palestinian authorities stated the operation was compromised after the special unit was discovered.

oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti duula addaa geggeeffameen hoogganaan garee Hamaas tokko qabamuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Israa'el tarkaanfichii kaayyoo shororkeessummaa dhabamsiisuuf akka ta'e ibsituus, qaamoleen falasxiin gama isaaniin gareen addaa kun erga beekamee booda haleellaan sun akka jabaate ibsaniiru.

title: Russian attack hits rail workers in new deadly strikes on Kyiv
english: Russian overnight missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas have resulted in at least 12 deaths and 20 injuries, including several railway employees. The attack damaged residential buildings and infrastructure as part of an ongoing campaign to weaken Ukrainian defenses and energy facilities. This surge in violence follows recent international calls, including from India’s Prime Minister, for a peaceful resolution to the conflict.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢው ባደረሰችው የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች መሞታቸው እና 20 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። በጥቃቱ የባቡር ሰራተኞች እና የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ተጎድተዋል፤ ይህ ድርጊት የዩክሬንን የመከላከያ አቅም ለማዳከም የታለመ የዘመቻ አካል እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈፀመው የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትርን ጨምሮ ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎች ጦርነቱ እንዲቆም ጥሪ ካቀረቡ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Rusiyan halkanii halkan magaalaa Kiyivii fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi droomiin geessisteen lubbuun namoota 12 yoo darbu, 20 ol madaa’aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame hogganoonni biyyoolessaa, dabalataanis muummichi ministeeraa Indiyaa waraana kana akka dhaaban erga gaafatanii booda.

title: Football Fandom: Who owns your loyalty?
english: The latest episode of Doha Debates explores the profound influence football fandom has on personal identity and community belonging. The program examines why people form deep emotional attachments to clubs and how this loyalty shapes their worldview. Through this discussion, the show questions the deeper significance of sports passion in our modern lives.

oromo: Sagantaan 'Doha Debates' guyyaa har'aa, jaalalli kubbaa miilaa eenyummaa fi miira walitti hidhamiinsa hawaasummaa irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabu qorata. Marii kana keessatti, sagantichi jireenya keenya har'aa keessatti jaalalli ispoortii hiika akkamii akka qabu gaaffii keessa galcha.

title: Barcelona sign Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal for a reported $11.6m
english: Barcelona has officially acquired Brazilian striker Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal for approximately $11.6 million on a contract lasting until 2029. The club turned to Jesus as an alternative after failing to secure Julian Alvarez from Atletico Madrid to strengthen their attacking line. Coach Hansi Flick expressed excitement about the signing, noting that the player's style is a great fit for the team's tactics.
amharic: ባርሴሎና የብራዚላዊውን አጥቂ ገብርኤል ጄሱስን ከአርሰናል በ11.6 ሚሊየን ዶላር እስከ 2029 በሚቆይ ውል ማስፈረሙን ይፋ አድርጓል። ክለቡ ይህንን ዝውውር የፈጸመው ከአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ ጁሊያን አልቫሬዝን ለማስፈረም ያደረገው ሙከራ ስላልተሳካ የፊት መስመር ጥቃቱን ለማጠናከር ነው። የቡድኑ አሰልጣኝ ሀንዚ ፍሊክ የተጫዋቹ የጨዋታ ዘይቤ ለቡድኑ ፍልስፍና ተስማሚ በመሆኑ በዝውውሩ መደሰታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Barcelona weeraraa biyya Brazil Gabri'eel Jeesusis kilabii Arsenal irraa doolaara miiliyoona 11.6 ta'uun hanga bara 2029tti isa tursiisuun mallatteessiseera. Kilabichi murtoo kana kan godhe erga Atleetikoo Maadrid irraa Juuliyaan Aalvaarez gahuu dadhabee booda, sarara dursaa isaa cimsuuf jecha ture. Leenjisaan garee kanaa Haanzii Fliik akka ibsanitti, akaakuun tapha taphataa kanaa tarsiimoo garee isaanii wajjin waan wal simatuuf, dhufaatiin isaa fayyadamummaa guddaa akka qabu dubbataniiru.

title: Who is Alejandro Betancourt, ex-Chavez ally now Trump’s Venezuela oil man?
english: Alejandro Betancourt, a controversial businessman known for his past ties to Venezuela's former government, has been chosen by the Trump administration to lead a major U.S.-backed oil project. This deal allows the U.S. to take significant control over Venezuela's oil reserves through Betancourt’s energy company. Although he is a powerful figure, Betancourt has faced numerous international allegations regarding corruption and money laundering throughout his career.
amharic: አሌሃንድሮ ቤታንኮርት የተባሉ አወዛጋቢ የንግድ ሰው፣ ከቀድሞው የቬኔዝዌላ መንግስት ጋር በነበራቸው ግንኙነት ይታወቃሉ። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር አሁን በቬኔዝዌላ በሚካሄድ ትልቅ የነዳጅ ፕሮጀክት ላይ እንዲመሩ መርጠዋቸዋል። ይህ ስምምነት አሜሪካ በቤታንኮርት የነዳጅ ኩባንያ በኩል የቬኔዝዌላን የነዳጅ ክምችት እንድትቆጣጠር ያስችላታል። ቢሆንም፣ ቤታንኮርት በሙስና እና በገንዘብ ማጠብ ወንጀል ከተለያዩ ሀገራት ምርመራ ሲካሄድባቸው የቆዩ ሰው ናቸው።
oromo: Alejandro Betancourt namicha daldalaa cimaa fi wal-falmisiisaa yoo ta'u, kanaan dura mootummaa Venezueelaa waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qaba ture. Mootummaan Donald Trump proojektii boba'aa guddaa Venezueelaa keessatti gaggeeffamu akka dursu filatee jira. Waligalteen kun Ameerikaan qabeenya boba'aa Venezueelaa irratti to'annoo akka qabaattu kan taasisu yoo ta'u, namichi kunis duula kana keessatti gahee guddaa qaba. Haa ta'u malee, Betancourt hojii isaa keessatti himannaa malaammaltummaa fi qabeenya seeran alaa qulqulleessuu hedduu mudatee jira.

title: Napoli’s ex Man Utd star McTominay needs surgery for irregular heartbeat
english: Napoli midfielder and former Manchester United player Scott McTominay is set to undergo a minor surgery to correct an irregular heartbeat. The Scottish international will be sidelined from professional play until October as he recovers from the procedure. He is expected to return to the pitch following the conclusion of the upcoming international break.
amharic: የናፖሊው አማካይ እና የቀድሞው የማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ ተጫዋች ስኮት ማክቶሚናይ፣ የልብ ምት መዛባትን ለማስተካከል በቀዶ ጥገና ሕክምና እንዲያደርግ ተወስኗል። የስኮትላንድ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አባል የሆነው ይህ ተጫዋች፣ ከቀዶ ጥገናው በኋላ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማገገም እስከ ጥቅምት ወር ድረስ ከሜዳ ይርቃል። ከዓለም አቀፍ የጨዋታ እረፍት በኋላ ወደ ሜዳ እንደሚመለስ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Taphataan giddu galeessa Napoli fi durii Manchester United kan ta'e Scott McTominay, dhukkuba onnee isaa waliin walqabatu wal'aanuuf baqaqsanii hodhuu akka godhuuf murtaa'eera. Taphatichi biyya Iskootlaandi kun, erga wal'aansa isaa xumuree booda hanga ji'a Onkoloolessaatti dirree taphaatii kan irraa fagaatu ta'a. Hojii isaa idilee kan itti fufuufis xumura boqonnaa tapha biyyoolessaa irratti akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: How wildfires are scorching France’s wine industry
english: France's renowned wine industry is facing significant threats as climate change leads to record-breaking heat and intense wildfires. These extreme temperatures cause grapes to ripen too quickly, altering their chemical balance and alcohol levels. Furthermore, massive wildfires have destroyed vast areas of land, particularly impacting iconic wine-producing regions like Bordeaux.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ታዋቂ የወይን ኢንዱስትሪ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት በከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና በሰደድ እሳት ስጋት ላይ ወድቋል። ከፍተኛው የሙቀት መጠኑ ወይኖች በፍጥነት እንዲበስሉ በማድረግ ጣዕማቸውን እና የአልኮል ይዘታቸውን እንዲቀይር አድርጓል። በተጨማሪም፣ ሰፊ የደን ቃጠሎዎች በተለይም እንደ ቦርዶ ባሉ ታዋቂ የወይን ምርት አካባቢዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ውድመት አስከትለዋል።
oromo: Indastiriin wayinii Faransaay kan beekamu, jijjiirama qilleensaa irraa kan ka'e ho'a guddaa fi ibidda bosonaa sodaachisaa ta'een miidhamaa jira. Ho'i kun firii wayinii saffisaan akka bilchaatu taasisuun, qabiyyee isaa fi alkoolii isaa jijjiireera. Kana malees, ibidda bosonaa babal'ataa dhufeen, keessattuu naannolee wayinii akka Bordootti lafa hedduu gubee balleesseera.

title: The final minutes before floodwater crashed through Nepal-China border
english: A massive flash flood containing mud, ice, and heavy boulders devastated the border area between Nepal and China on August 26, destroying the vital Friendship Bridge and nearby customs facilities. CCTV footage and satellite images confirm that the surge of water swept away buildings along the valley floor in both Gyirong and Rasuwagadhi. Authorities are currently working to determine the fate of many people, including numerous travelers and pilgrims, who were in the region when the disaster occurred.
amharic: ነሐሴ 20 ቀን በኔፓል እና በቻይና ድንበር አካባቢ የተከሰተ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ጭቃን፣ በረዶን እና ግዙፍ ድንጋዮችን በመያዝ የሁለቱን አገራት ድንበር የሚያገናኘውን ድልድይና የጉምሩክ ተቋማትን አውድሟል። የካሜራ ምስሎች እና የሳተላይት መረጃዎች ጎርፉ በጂሮንግ እና በራስዋጋዲ አካባቢ የሚገኙ ሕንፃዎችን በሙሉ ጠራርጎ መውሰዱን ያሳያሉ። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ወቅት በስፍራው የነበሩ ተጓዦችን እና ነዋሪዎችን ሁኔታ ለማጣራት እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Muddee 20, biyyoota Neephaal fi Chaayinaa gidduutti lolaan tasa ka'e biyyee, cabbii fi dhagaa gurguddaa of keessatti qabatee gandaa fi buufataalee daangaa irratti argaman guutummaatti barbadeesseera. Suuraawwan kaameroota CCTV fi marsaa samiirraa kaafaman akka agarsiisanitti, lolaan kun ganda Gyirong fi Rasuwagadhi keessa kan turan ijaarsaalee hunda haxaa'ee darbeera. Yeroo ammaa mootummaan namoota yeroo lolaa sana achi turan, kanneen akka imaltootaa fi namoota biroo hubachuuf qorannoo gochaa jira.

title: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
english: A former gang leader named Duane Davis has been convicted for his role in the 1996 drive-by shooting that killed hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. Although Davis did not pull the trigger himself, prosecutors successfully argued that he orchestrated the attack and provided the weapon used by his nephew. This verdict finally resolves a nearly 30-year-old cold case that had remained one of the most mysterious crimes in music history.
amharic: ዱዌን ዴቪስ የተባሉ የቀድሞ የቡድን መሪ እ.ኤ.አ. በ1996 በላስ ቬጋስ የሂፕ-ሆፕ ኮከቡን ቱፓክ ሻኩርን በመግደል ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ዴቪስ ራሳቸው ጥይቱን ባይተኩሱም፣ ጥቃቱን በማቀናበር ለወንድማቸው ልጅ መሳሪያውን እንዳቀበሉ አቃቤ ህጎች በማስረጃ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ላለፉት 30 ዓመታት መፍትሄ ሳይበጅለት የቆየውን እና የሙዚቃውን ዓለም ሲያነጋግር የነበረውን ታዋቂ የወንጀል ክስ የቋጨ ነው።
oromo: Duwaan Deevis kan jedhaman hoogganaan garee kaleessaa, bara 1996 magaala Las Veegasitti ajjeechaa weellisaa beekamaa Tupaak Shaakur irratti raawwatamee ture qindeessuun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Deevis ofumaan rasaasa dhukaasuu baatanis, ajjeechaa kana qindeessanii fi meeshaa waraanaa ilmi obboleessa isaanii itti fayyadame dhiyeessuu isaanii abbaan alangaa ragaadhaan mirkaneessaniiru. Murtii kanaan waggoota 30 oliif utuu hin furamin turee fi seenaa muuziqaa keessatti kan nama ajaa'ibu ture, xumura argateera.

title: Amazon rigged $20bn worth of ad prices, US lawsuit alleges
english: The US Federal Trade Commission and 22 states have filed a lawsuit accusing Amazon of manipulating advertising auctions to unfairly inflate prices. The complaint alleges that the company secretly overcharged businesses by replacing auction results with higher figures, potentially generating $20 billion in extra profit since 2019. Amazon has denied these claims, arguing that the lawsuit is based on a misunderstanding of how their advertising platform operates.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ንግድ ኮሚሽን እና 22 ግዛቶች አማዞን የማስታወቂያ ጨረታዎችን በማጭበርበር ዋጋውን ያለ አግባብ ከፍ አድርጓል በሚል ክስ መስርተዋል። ኩባንያው ከ2019 ጀምሮ የጨረታ ውጤቶችን በመቀየር ከደንበኞቹ እስከ 20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ተጨማሪ ትርፍ አግኝቷል ተብሎ ይከሰሳል። አማዞን በበኩሉ ይህ ክስ የተሳሳተ መሆኑን እና የማስታወቂያ መድረኩን አሠራር በተሳሳተ መንገድ መረዳታቸውን በመግለጽ ውንጀላውን አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Komishiniin Daldala Federaalaa Ameerikaa fi namoonni biroo 22, Amazon gabaa beeksisaa keessatti gatii dabarsuun soba raawwate jechuun himatanii jiru. Himatni kun akka jedhutti, Amazon bara 2019 irraa eegalee bu'aa caalbaasii beeksisaa jijjiiruun qarshii biiliyoona 20 ol ta'u hatattamaan bu'aa guddaa akka argate ibsa. Amazon gama isaatiin himata kana kan mormu yoo ta'u, himatni kun mala itti fayyadama beeksisa isaanii hubachuu dhabuu irraa kan maddeedha jedhee deebiseera.

title: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill at least four, including children
english: Israeli military drone strikes in Gaza have resulted in at least four deaths, including two children, and left several others injured. The attacks occurred across different locations, notably in the al-Kateeba district of Gaza City and Deir el-Balah. While Israel claims these operations were conducted to neutralize threats, the intensity of the drone strikes caused significant chaos and destruction in the area.
amharic: በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል፤ ከተገደሉት መካከል ሁለት ሕፃናት ይገኙበታል። ጥቃቶቹ በጋዛ ከተማ አል-ካቲባ አውራጃ እና በዴር ኤል-ባላህ አካባቢ የተፈጸሙ ናቸው። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው ስጋት ያላቸውን ኢላማዎች ለማስወገድ እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ የተጠናከረው የድሮን እንቅስቃሴ በቦታው ላይ ከፍተኛ ሁከትና ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Hojiin weerara xiyyaara kashilaa (drone) Israa'el daangaa Gaazaatti geggeessiteen lubbuun namoota afur yoo darbu, isaan keessaa lama ijoollee dha. Haleellaan kun magaalota Gaazaa fi Deer el-Balaah keessatti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, namoota hedduu miidhee jira. Israa'el haleellaa kana kan raawwatte sodaa jiru hambisuuf ta'uu ibsituus, sochii xiyyaara kashilaa cimaa ta'een naannichatti jeequmsaa fi miidhaan guddaan uumamee jira.

title: Football power struggle caused FIFA World Cup plan fallout, says Kushner
english: Joshua Kushner, a prominent venture capitalist, has expressed regret over his involvement in a failed FIFA plan to sell World Cup commercial rights to private investors. He blamed the project's collapse on complex political conflicts within global football and claimed his firm would have avoided the deal had they foreseen the intense backlash. Meanwhile, UEFA is pursuing legal action against FIFA President Gianni Infantino, alleging the secret proposal amounted to criminal mismanagement.
amharic: ታዋቂው የኢንቨስትመንት ባለሙያ ጆሹዋ ኩሽነር፣ የዓለም ዋንጫን የንግድ መብቶች ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ታቅዶ የነበረው እና ውድቅ የሆነው የፊፋ ፕሮጀክት ውስጥ በመሳተፋቸው መጸጸታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የፕሮጀክቱ መክሸፍ በዓለም አቀፍ እግር ኳስ ውስጥ ባለው የተወሳሰበ የፖለቲካ ፍጥጫ ምክንያት እንደሆነ የገለጹት ኩሽነር፣ ጉዳዩ ይህን ያህል ውዝግብ እንደሚያስነሳ አስቀድመው ቢያውቁ ኖሮ ከዚህ ስምምነት ይርቁ እንደነበር ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ዩኤፋ የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በድብቅ ባቀረቡት በዚህ ሀሳብ ላይ የወንጀል ክስ ለመመስረት እንቅስቃሴ ጀምሯል።
oromo: Hojjetaan invastimantii beekamaan Jooshuwaa Kushnar, sagantaa FIFA kan dursee qophaa'ee ture fi mirga daldalaa Waldaa Kubbaa Miilaa Addunyaa (World Cup) investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfame keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitti gaabbuu ibsaniiru. Kufaatiin sagantichaa walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa kubbaa miilaa addunyaa keessa jiruun kan dhufe ta'uu fi rakkoo kana duraan beekanii utuu ta'ee, dhaabbanni isaanii dhimma kana keessa akka hin galle dubbataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Yuuefaan (UEFA) pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo irratti himata yakkaa banuuf qophii taasisaa jira; kunis dhimmi kun iccitiin kan qophaa'e fi bulchiinsa sirrii hin taane akka ta'e himachuudhaani.

title: Russian drone and missile barrage kills at least 12 in Ukraine’s Kyiv
english: A massive overnight Russian aerial attack involving missiles and drones has killed at least 12 people and injured many others in Kyiv and its surrounding regions. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the violence as terrorism and urged international allies to urgently strengthen the country's air defense systems. The strikes caused significant damage to residential buildings and infrastructure, while retaliatory Ukrainian drone attacks were also reported inside Russian territory.
amharic: በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢው የተፈጸመው ግዙፍ የሩሲያ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎችም ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን የሽብር ተግባር በማለት ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ አጋር ሀገራት የዩክሬንን የአየር መከላከያ አቅም በአስቸኳይ እንዲያጠናክሩ ጠይቀዋል። ጥቃቱ በመኖሪያ ቤቶች እና በሌሎች መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን፣ በምላሹም ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን ፈጽማለች።
oromo: Halkan darbetti biyyi Raashiyaa xiyyaara malee (drones) fi misaa'elii fayyadamuun magaalaa Kiyivii fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa geggeessiteen namoonni 12 ol du'anii, hedduun isaanii immoo miidhaniiru. Preezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zelenskii haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, biyyoonni michuu ta'an kan Yukreen dandeettii ittisa qilleensa ishee akka cimsattuuf gargaarsa akka godhan gaafataniiru. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti miidhaa guddaa kan geessise yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin Yukreenis daangaa Raashiyaa keessatti haleellaa deebii dronootaan geggeessitee jirti.

title: Heavy monsoon rains submerge Islamabad roads and underground
english: Severe monsoon rains have caused significant flooding across Islamabad and Rawalpindi in Pakistan, leading to submerged streets and water entering homes. In response to the dangerous conditions and rising water levels, local authorities have decided to shut down schools. The extreme weather has disrupted daily life in both cities as emergency teams deal with the impact of the downpour.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ኢስላማባድ እና ራዋልፒንዲ ከተሞች የጣለው ከባድ የዝናብ ወቅት ጎርፍ መንገዶችን በማጥለቅለቅ ወደ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ገብቷል። በጎርፉ ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን አደጋ ለመከላከል እና የውሃው መጠን እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ ባለስልጣናት ትምህርት ቤቶችን ዘግተዋል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ ለሁለቱ ከተሞች ነዋሪዎች ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan yeroo gannaa Paakistaan magaalaawwan Islamaabaad fi Raawalpindii keessatti bal’inaan roobee, daandiiwwan akka guutuufi manoota keessatti akka seenu taasiseera. Haala sodaachisaa fi lolaan dabalaa dhufu kana hordofee, qaamoleen mootummaa manneen barnootaa akka cufan ajajaniiru. Hawaasni naannichaa balaa rooba kanaan miidhamuu isaatiin jireenyi guyyuu isaanii guutummaatti addaan citeera.

title: ‘Not welcome’: How Sweden’s far right took over Stockholm Central Station
english: The Sweden Democrats, a far-right political party, recently launched an aggressive advertising campaign at Stockholm Central Station and on local buses targeting immigrants with exclusionary rhetoric. The posters, which call for the repatriation of individuals of Somali heritage and criticize migrants for various social issues, have caused significant distress among immigrant communities. While some transit operators removed the controversial ads following protests from staff, the campaign highlights the rising influence of the far-right party ahead of the upcoming national elections.
amharic: የስዊድን ዴሞክራቶች የተሰኘው እጅግ አክራሪ የፖለቲካ ቡድን፣ በስቶክሆልም ማዕከላዊ ባቡር ጣቢያ እና በአውቶቡሶች ላይ ስደተኞችን የሚያገል ማስታወቂያ ዘመቻ አድርጓል። ሶማሊያዊ ተወላጆች ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ የሚጠይቁት እና ስደተኞችን በወንጀልና በሌሎች ጉዳዮች የሚከሱት እነዚህ ማስታወቂያዎች፣ በስደተኛ ማህበረሰቡ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋትና ብስጭት ፈጥረዋል። አንዳንድ የትራንስፖርት ተቋማት ተቃውሞዎችን ተከትሎ ማስታወቂያዎቹን ለማስወገድ ቢገደዱም፣ ይህ ድርጊት ግን ከመጪው ምርጫ በፊት የስዊድን እጅግ አክራሪ ፓርቲዎች ተጽዕኖ እያደገ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin mirga-xumuraa 'Sweden Democrats' jedhamu, buufata baaburaa giddu-galeessa Stockholm fi konkolaataalee ummataa irratti duula beeksisoota godaantota jibbuu fi baasu irratti xiyyeeffatu gaggeesseera. Beeksisootni kun lammiilee seenaa Somaaliyaa qaban gara biyya isaaniitti akka deebi'an kan gaafatuu fi godaantota yakka fi rakkoolee biroo keessatti qooda qabu jechuun kan komatu dha. Gariin dhaabbilee geejjibaa mormii hojjettootaa booda beeksisoota kana buusuu kan dirqaman yoo ta'u, gochi kun filannoo biyyoolessaa dhufu dura dhiibbaan paartilee mirga-xumuraa Swiidin keessatti dabalaa dhufuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Israeli strikes pound Gaza, killing at least two children
english: Recent Israeli military strikes across Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least two children. The attacks caused significant chaos in densely populated areas, forcing the evacuation of a school and a field hospital. While Israel stated the operations were intended to eliminate security threats, the situation remains unstable as medical facilities continue to treat those injured.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በጋዛ ቢያንስ ሁለት ህጻናት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ ከፍተኛ ህዝብ በሚኖርባቸው አካባቢዎች ውዥንብር የፈጠረ ሲሆን ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና የድንገተኛ ህክምና ጣቢያዎችን ለቆ ለመውጣት ተገዷል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው የደህንነት ስጋቶችን ለመቅረፍ እንደሆነ የገለጸች ሲሆን፣ በደረሰው ጉዳት የቆሰሉ ሰዎች ወደ ሆስፒታል መላካቸው ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gaazaa keessatti haleellaa geggeesseen ijoolleen lama du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun bakka namoonni baay'inaan jiraatanitti waan raawwatameef, manneen barnootaa fi hospitaalli dirree akka gadi lakkisan dirqisiiseera. Israa'el haleellaa kana kan geggeessite sodaalee nageenyaa hambisuuf ta'uu ibsite; haala walxaxaa kanaan miidhamtoonni baay'een gara hospitaalaatti ergamaa jiru.

title: Ben Gvir bars Jewish anti-Zionist movement from carrying guns
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has expanded a policy that makes it easier for civilians to obtain gun licenses to include the city of Beit Shemesh. However, he specifically excluded the anti-Zionist ultra-Orthodox group Neturei Karta from this program. Ben Gvir justified this decision by labeling the group as enemies due to their public opposition to the state and their support for Palestinian causes.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር ሲቪሎች የጦር መሳሪያ ፍቃድ ለማግኘት ቀላል የሚያደርገውን አዲስ መመሪያ ወደ ቤት ሸሜሽ ከተማ አስፋፍተዋል። ሆኖም ሚኒስትሩ ኔቱሬይ ካርታ የተባለውን ጸረ-ጽዮናዊ የሃይማኖት ቡድን ከአዲሱ መብት አግልለዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰኑት ቡድኑ የእስራኤልን መንግስት በመቃወም እና የፍልስጤማውያንን ወገን በመደገፍ ጠላትነት ያሳያሉ በሚል ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Ministirri nageenya biyyaa Israa'el Itamar Ben Gvir seera namootni hedduun meeshaa waraanaa akka hidhatan hayyamu gara magaalaa Beet Shemeshitti bal'iseera. Haa ta'u malee, garee amantii Neturei Karta kan Israa'elittii fi Si'onizimii mormu ta'e sirna kana keessaa baaseera. Ministirichi murtee kana kan dabarse, gareen kun mootummaa Israa'el mormuufi gama Falastiiwotaa deeggara jechuun akka diinaatti waan ilaaluufi.

title: Why China-Egypt cooperation has nothing to do with great-power rivalry
english: China and Egypt are celebrating 70 years of diplomatic relations, with many Western observers incorrectly viewing the partnership as a tool for geopolitical rivalry. In reality, the collaboration is focused on practical development, such as the successful Teda Suez industrial zone and essential transport infrastructure like Cairo's light rail. These projects prioritize Egypt's long-term economic growth and industrial independence rather than acting as a simple extension of superpower competition.
amharic: ቻይና እና ግብፅ የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነታቸውን 70ኛ ዓመት እያከበሩ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ ምዕራባውያን ይህ ግንኙነት በታላላቅ ኃያላን መካከል የሚደረግ የፖለቲካ ሽኩቻ አካል እንደሆነ አድርገው ይገመግማሉ። ሆኖም ግን፣ የሁለቱ አገራት ትብብር በዋናነት የሚያተኩረው እንደ ቴዳ ሱዌዝ የኢንዱስትሪ ቀጠና እና የካይሮ የባቡር ትራንስፖርት ባሉ ተግባራዊ ልማቶች ላይ ነው። እነዚህ ፕሮጀክቶች የኃያላን መንግስታት ፉክክር ሳይሆን፣ የግብፅን የረጅም ጊዜ የኢኮኖሚ እድገት እና የኢንዱስትሪ አቅም ለማጠናከር የተነደፉ ናቸው።
oromo: Chaayinaan fi Gibxi waggaa 70ffaa walitti dhufeenya dippilomaasii isaanii kabajaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, biyyoonni lixaa tokko tokko walitti dhufeenya kana akka morkii humnoota gurguddoo addunyaatti ilaalu. Dhugaan isaa garuu, walta'iinsi kun kan hundaa'e karoora misoomaa qabatamaa irratti, kan akka industirii 'Teda Suez' fi tajaajila baaburaa magaalaa Kaayiroo fa'i. Hojiileen kun morkii siyaasaa caalaa, fedhii Gibxi kan guddina diinagdee fi of-danda'uu industirii irratti kan xiyyeeffatan dha.

title: Iran has enough foreign currency despite US sanctions, central bank chief says
english: The Governor of Iran's Central Bank stated that the country possesses adequate foreign currency reserves to withstand ongoing US sanctions. He plans to release up to $2 billion into the market to stabilize currency fluctuations. While acknowledging economic difficulties, he dismissed concerns about a national financial collapse as mere psychological pressure.
amharic: የኢራን ማዕከላዊ ባንክ ገዢ ሀገሪቱ በአሜሪካ ማዕቀቦች መሃል እንኳን በቂ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ክምችት እንዳላት አስታውቀዋል። የገበያ መዋዠቅን ለማረጋጋት እስከ ሁለት ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚደርስ ገንዘብ ወደ ገበያ እንደሚለቅም ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን የኢኮኖሚ ተግዳሮቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ሀገሪቱ ትፈራርሳለች የሚለውን የውጭ አካላት አስተያየት በመቃወም የኢኮኖሚው ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Geggeessaan baankii giddu galeessa Iraan, biyyattiin miidhaa sanadoota Ameerikaa jala taatus qabeenya maallaqa alaa gahaa akka qabdu ibseera. Jijjiirama gatii maallaqaa tasgabbeessuuf hanga biiliyoona lamaan ol ta'u gabaa keessa akka galchu beeksisera. Rakkooleen dinagdee jiranis, biyyattiin kuftiina dinagdee keessa seenti jedhamee oduun oofamu soba ta'uu fi dinagdeen isaanii jabaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: Top Israeli intelligence official secretly traveled to US for 'sensitive' talks: Report
english: The director of Israel's Shin Bet security agency, David Zini, recently made a private trip to Washington, D.C. During his visit, he held high-level meetings with officials from the FBI. While the specific topics remain undisclosed, reports describe the discussions as involving sensitive security matters.

oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata nageenyaa Israa'el 'Shin Bet' Daawit Ziinii, icciitiidhaan gara magaalaa Waashingitan imalee jira. Imala isaa kanaanis qondaaltota biiroo qorannoo federaalaa Amerikaa (FBI) waliin wal arguun mari'ataniiru. Haata'u malee, waa'ee marii isaanii bal'inaan kan hin ibsamne yoo ta'u, dhimmoonni ka'an gama nageenyaatiin kanneen baay'ee yaaddoo qabaniidha jedhameera.

title: US army secretary resigns after months of tension
english: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned following persistent disagreements with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Known for his focus on military drone technology and close ties to the Trump administration, Driscoll is the latest in a series of high-ranking officials to leave the Pentagon. His departure occurs amidst a broader trend of military leadership changes under the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር ሠራዊት ዋና ጸሐፊ ዳን ድሪስኮል ከመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ ጋር ለወራት ሲካሄድ በቆየው አለመግባባት ምክንያት ስራቸውን ለቀዋል። በወታደራዊ ድሮን ቴክኖሎጂ ላይ ባላቸው ትኩረት እና ከፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ጋር ባላቸው የቅርብ ግንኙነት የሚታወቁት ድሪስኮል፣ በቅርቡ ከስልጣን ከለቀቁ ከፍተኛ የመከላከያ ባለስልጣናት መካከል አንዱ ሆነዋል። ይህ ድርጊት አሁን ባለው አስተዳደር ስር በወታደራዊ አመራሮች ላይ እየተደረገ ካለው ተደጋጋሚ ለውጥ ጋር ተያይዞ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan waraana Ameerikaa Dan Dristikool, ministira ittisaa Piit Heegseet waliin wal dhabdee turte hordofee hojii isaa gadhiiseera. Teeknooloojii dooniin (drone) waraanaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo kennuunsaa fi hoggansa Tiramp waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qabaachuunsaa kan beekamu Dristikool, itti gaafatamtoota olaanoo Pentagaan irraa gadi ba'aa jiran keessaa isa tokko. Gadhiisuun inni hojii isaa gadhiise kun, jijjiirama hoggansa waraana kanneen amma mootummaan amma jiru keessatti mul'achaa jiru keessaa tokko dha.

title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
english: Over six million Afghans have been forced to return to their home country from Pakistan and Iran due to strict crackdowns on migrants. Many of these individuals, including those born abroad who have never lived in Afghanistan, are arriving with no resources and nowhere to stay. International organizations describe this as an unprecedented humanitarian crisis, as these families struggle to survive in a nation already facing severe poverty.
amharic: ፓኪስታን እና ኢራን በስደተኞች ላይ በወሰዱት ጥብቅ እርምጃ ከስድስት ሚሊዮን በላይ አፍጋኒስታውያን ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ ተገደዋል። ከእነዚህ መካከል አብዛኞቹ በውጭ ሀገር የተወለዱ እና አፍጋኒስታን ውስጥ ኖረው የማያውቁ በመሆናቸው፣ ምንም አይነት መተዳደሪያና መጠለያ ሳይኖራቸው ለከፋ ችግር ተጋልጠዋል። ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች ይህንን ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ ተመላሾቹ በከፍተኛ ድህነት ውስጥ በሚገኝ ሀገር ውስጥ ህልውናቸውን ለማስጠበቅ እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pakiistaanii fi Iraan godaantota irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu isaaniitiin, namoonni Afgaanistaan biiliyoona ja'a ol ta'an gara biyya isaanii deebi'uuf dirqamaniiru. Namoonni kun hedduun isaanii biyya alatti dhalatanii waan guddataniif, Afgaanistaan keessa jiraatanii hin beekan; amma garuu qabeenyaafi bakka buufatan tokko malee rakkina guddaa keessa jiru. Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa miidhaa kana rakkoo namoomaa isa hanga har'aatti mudate keessaa kan hin mul'anne jedhanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, namoonni deebi'an kunneen biyya hiyyummaan guute keessatti lubbuu isaanii jiraachisuuf qabsaa'aa jiru.

title: Former gang leader found guilty of Tupac Shakur’s 1996 murder
english: A Las Vegas jury has convicted former gang leader Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis for his role in the 1996 killing of rapper Tupac Shakur. Legal authorities established that Davis planned the retaliatory shooting and supplied the weapon used in the crime. The case was successfully reopened after Davis himself shared details about his involvement in the murder.
amharic: የላስ ቬጋስ ዳኞች የቀድሞ የጋንግ መሪ የነበረውን ዱዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስን በ1996 ዓ.ም የራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩርን ግድያ በመፈጸሙ ጥፋተኛ ብለውታል። አቃቤ ህግ እንደገለጸው ዴቪስ የበቀል ጥቃቱን በማቀድ ለተኩሱ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለውን መሳሪያ አቅራቢ ነበር። የጉዳዩ ምርመራ እንደገና የተከፈተው ዴቪስ ራሱ በግድያው ውስጥ ስላለው ተሳትፎ በሰጠው አስተያየት አማካኝነት ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Las Vegasitti halkan tokko dura hogganaa garee seeraan alaa Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis jedhamu, bara 1996 rapper Tupac Shakur ajjeesuu isaan itti murteesseera. Abbaan alangaa akka ibsetti, Davis haleellaa haaloo bahuuf yaadame sana qindeessuun alangee (qawwee) nama haleellaa raawwateef kenneera. Qorannoon dhimma kanaa kan deebi'ee baname, Davis mataan isaa waa'ee hirmaannaa isaa ajjeechaa kana keessatti himachuu isaan booda ture.

title: Algeria’s president seeks death penalty for those who start forest fires
english: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune is pushing for the death penalty for individuals who intentionally start forest fires following a series of deadly blazes that killed at least 12 people. The president has ordered a legal review to amend the penal code, noting that the simultaneous start of several fires suggests criminal activity. Additionally, he has directed local authorities to provide rapid compensation to affected families and restore essential services like water and electricity to the impacted regions.
amharic: የአልጄሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት አብደልማጂድ ተቡን፣ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎችን ለሞት የዳረጉትን የደን ቃጠሎዎች ሆን ብለው የሚጭሩ ሰዎች የሞት ቅጣት እንዲወሰንባቸው ጠይቀዋል። የሀገሪቱ የወንጀል ህግ እንዲሻሻል ትእዛዝ የሰጡት ፕሬዚዳንቱ፣ በአንድ ጊዜ የተነሱት ቃጠሎዎች በወንጀል ድርጊት የተፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን ጠቁመዋል። በተጨማሪም ለተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ፈጣን ካሳ እንዲከፈል እና የተቋረጡ መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች በአስቸኳይ እንዲመለሱ ለሚመለከታቸው አካላት መመሪያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Aljeeriyaa Abdelmaajid Tebbuun, ibidda bosonaa namoota 12 galaafate erga hordofee booda, namoota yaadanii ibidda kaasan irratti adabbii du'aa akka murteessuuf gaafatan. Pirezidaantichi seerri yakkaa akka fooyya'u ajajanii, ibiddoonni yeroo tokkotti ka'an kunneen shakkii yakkaa guddaa kan uuman ta'uu ibsaniiru. Kana malees, maatii miidhamaniif kaffaltii beenyaa ariifachiisaa akka kennamuufi tajaajiloonni bu'uuraa akka deebi'anii bakka bu'an qaamolee dhimmi ilaaluuf ajaja dabarsaniiru.

title: John Ternus to lead Apple into the age of AI
english: John Ternus is officially becoming Apple's new CEO, taking over for Tim Cook after his 15-year tenure. As an experienced hardware engineer, Ternus is expected to focus on product innovation to help the company catch up to competitors in the artificial intelligence sector. He will face immediate challenges, including navigating geopolitical tensions and managing the company's manufacturing reliance on China.
amharic: ጆን ተርነስ የ15 ዓመታት የአፕል ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ የነበሩትን ቲም ኩክን በመተካት አዲሱ የኩባንያው መሪ ሆነዋል። እንደ የሃርድዌር ምህንድስና ባለሙያነታቸው፣ ተርነስ ኩባንያው በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፍ ከባላንጣዎቹ ጋር እንዲወዳደር በማድረግ ላይ ትኩረት እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል። አዲሱ መሪ በቻይና ላይ ካለው የምርት ጥገኝነት እና ከፖለቲካዊ ጫናዎች ጋር የተያያዙ ተግዳሮቶችን የመፍታት ከባድ ኃላፊነት ይጠብቃቸዋል።
oromo: Joon Ternaas bakka Tiiym Kuuk bu’uun pirezidaantii fi hoji gaggeessaa olaanaa Apple ta’uun isaa beekameera. Inni injineera hardware ta’uu isaan, xiyyeeffannoon isaa guddina teeknoolojii fi dorgommummaa Apple damee 'Artificial Intelligence' keessatti cimsuu irratti ta’a jedhamee eegama. Ternaas haala qilleensa siyaasaa fi walitti dhufeenya Apple fi Chaayinaa gidduu jiru akkasumas dhiibbaa gara garaa haala gaariin hoogganuun itti gaafatamummaa guddaa qaba.

title: US brings back Russia’s Siluanov to G20 finance talks, angering Europe
english: The United States invited Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov to attend G20 financial meetings in North Carolina, marking his first in-person appearance at the forum since the invasion of Ukraine began. This decision has caused significant friction with European leaders, who criticized the move and expressed deep distrust toward Moscow. While the U.S. government defended the interaction as part of broader diplomatic efforts, European officials made their disapproval clear by distancing themselves from the Russian representative.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የሩሲያው የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር አንቶን ሲልዋኖቭን በሰሜን ካሮላይና በተካሄደው የጂ20 የፋይናንስ ስብሰባ ላይ እንዲገኙ መጋበዙ የአውሮፓ ሀገራትን ቅሬታ ቀስቅሷል። ይህ ከዩክሬን ጦርነት በኋላ ሚኒስትሩ በስብሰባው ላይ በአካል ተገኝተው ሲሳተፉ የመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ነው። የአውሮፓ ባለስልጣናት በሩሲያ ላይ ያላቸውን አለመተማመን በመግለጽ ውሳኔውን የተቹ ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካ በበኩሏ ይህንን የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት አካል እንደሆነ ተናግራለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa ministira maallaqaa Raashiyaa Anton Siluanov walga'ii maallaqa biyyoota G20 irratti akka hirmaatan afeeruun isaa hogganoota Awurooppaa biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Awurooppaa Raashiyaarratti amantii akka hinqabne ibsuun tarkaanfichatti gammadne jedhan, ta'us Ameerikaan tarkaanfichi yaalii dipilomaasii kan ta'eef akka ta'e dubbatteetti.

title: Toxic haze from Indonesian fires chokes Malaysia’s Sarawak
english: Severe haze caused by forest fires in Indonesia has blanketed Malaysia's Sarawak state, creating the region's most dangerous air quality crisis in ten years. The toxic smoke has led to a significant increase in respiratory and eye-related illnesses across the country, forcing the cancellation of major public events. Local authorities have recorded hazardous pollution levels, severely impacting daily life and the health of vulnerable residents.

title: Five vessels transit Hormuz Strait on Monday, remaining below average traffic
english: On Monday, only five commodity ships traveled through the Strait of Hormuz, maintaining a volume of traffic that remains below typical levels. Four of these vessels entered the channel, including three dry bulk carriers and an empty gas tanker, while one vessel departed. This data, provided by ship-tracking services, indicates stable but quiet maritime activity in the region.

oromo: Dilbata darbe, markaleen gurgurtaa shan qofa ta'an daandii galaana Hormuz kan darban yoo ta'u, kunis hojii daandii galaanichaa kan yeroo hundaarraa kan gadii ta'uu agarsiisa. title: Israeli troops advance further into Syria’s Daraa
english: Israeli military forces have been observed moving deeper into the Daraa province of Syria. Multiple armored vehicles and surveillance planes were seen operating near the village of Jumla. These activities indicate a significant expansion of their presence in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ወደ ሶሪያው ዳራ ግዛት ጠልቀው እየገቡ መሆኑ ተዘግቧል። በጁምላ መንደር አካባቢ በርካታ የታጠቁ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና የስለላ አውሮፕላኖች ሲንቀሳቀሱ ታይተዋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በአካባቢው የነበራቸውን መገኘት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዳሰፋው ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gara kutaa biyya Suriyaa kan ta'e Daraa keessatti gara fuulduraatti deemaa akka jiran gabaafameera. Konkolaattoota waraanaa fi xiyyaarota qorannoo hedduutu baadiyaa Jumlaa jedhamtu biratti argameera. Tarkaanfiin kun haala jiru keessatti dhiibbaa fi humna isaanii akka babal'isanii jiran agarsiisa.

title: Vance says US now focused on free flow of commerce in Hormuz Strait
english: US Vice President JD Vance stated that Washington's current priority is protecting international trade routes through the Strait of Hormuz. He explained that recent military actions against Iranian forces were necessary to stop them from mining the waterway. Vance further criticized Iran's leadership, labeling their aggressive attempts to disrupt global oil and gas supplies as irrational and strategically unwise.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ዋሽንግተን በአሁኑ ወቅት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የንግድ እንቅስቃሴዎች ያለ ምንም እንቅፋት እንዲቀጥሉ ቅድሚያ ሰጥታ እየሰራች መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። በቅርቡ በአየርላንድ ላይ የተወሰደው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ኢራን በውሃ መስመሩ ላይ ፈንጂ የመትከል ሙከራዋን ለማስቆም የታለመ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። ቫንስ የኢራን መሪዎች የነዳጅ እና የጋዝ አቅርቦትን ለማስተጓጎል የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ስትራቴጂያዊ ጥበብ የጎደለው እና ምክንያታዊ ያልሆነ ድርጊት መሆኑን ተችተዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, xiyyeeffannoon Washington yeroo ammaa karaa markabaa Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz) daldalli akka walirraa hin cinne mirkaneessuu dha. Gochi waraanaa dhiyeenya kana Iran irratti raawwatame, Iran karaa bishaanii kana keessa boombii dhaabuuf yaalii goote dhaabsisuuf kan godhame ta'uu ibsaniiru. Vance hogganoonni Iran gabaa boba'aa fi gaazii addunyaa miidhuuf yaalii godhan gocha raawwatamu hin qabne fi mala kan hin qabne ta'uu balaaleffataniiru.

title: US Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll submits resignation, media reports say
english: US Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll has resigned from his position following a period of ongoing friction with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. While the White House praised his contributions to military readiness and foreign policy, it remains uncertain if his departure has been officially accepted. His resignation continues a trend of high-level personnel changes within the Pentagon under the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር ኃይል ሚኒስትር ዳንኤል ድሪስኮል ከመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ ጋር በነበራቸው አለመግባባት ምክንያት ስልጣናቸውን መልቀቃቸው ተነግሯል። ዋይት ሀውስ ለሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ዝግጁነት ላደረጉት አስተዋጽኦ ምስጋና ቢሰጥም፣ መልቀቂያቸው በይፋ መጽደቁ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም። ይህ ክስተት በአሁኑ አስተዳደር ስር በፔንታጎን ውስጥ እየተደረጉ ካሉ ተከታታይ ከፍተኛ የሹመት ለውጦች አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri Waraana Ameerikaa Daani'eel Diriskool, ministeera ittisa biyyaa Piit Hegseet wajjin wal dhabdee turtee booda hojii gadhiisuu isaanii gabaafameera. Mana maree adii keessatti gumaacha isaan waraanaaf taasisan yoo dinqisiifatanillee, gadi lhiisuun isaanii sirritti fudhatamuun isaa ammatti hin mirkanaa'e. Kunis mootummaa amma jiru jalatti hoggantoonni olaanoo pentagonii irraa akkaataa itti gaggeeffamaa jiran keessaa tokko dha.

title: Three minors killed in Colombia armed group crackdown
english: A recent Colombian military airstrike targeting dissident FARC rebels in the Guaviare region resulted in the deaths of 10 people, including three teenagers. President Abelardo de la Espriella has intensified operations against these armed groups, which are increasingly using social media to recruit children into their ranks. Human Rights Watch reports that over 1,500 children have been recruited by such groups since 2021, often for dangerous combat roles.

oromo: Humni waraana Kolombiyaa gartuu finxaaleyyii FARC irratti qilleensa irraan haleellaa geggeesseen, dargaggoota sadii dabalatee namoonni kudhan du'aniiru. Pirezidaantiin biyyattii Abelardo de la Espriella gartuuwwan hidhattootaa irratti duula gaggeessaa jiran yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni kunneen miidiyaa hawaasaa fayyadamuun ijoollee akka waraanaatti malaammaluun isaanii ibsameera. Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa akka gabaasetti, bara 2021 irraa eegalee ijoolleen kuma 1.5 ol ta'an gartuuwwan hidhattootaan akka malee qabamanii hojiiwwan balaa qaban keessatti bobbaafamaa jiru.

title: JERUSALEM DAILY: JOURNALISTS ATTACKED
english: In the occupied West Bank, journalists from NBC were targeted during attacks by Israeli settlers against Palestinians. Meanwhile, the conflict in Gaza continues with the tragic death of a three-year-old child following an Israeli airstrike. Additionally, Israeli Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has drawn criticism for sharing AI-generated imagery featuring Palestinian detainees.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ጥቃት በሚሰነዝሩበት ወቅት የኤንቢሲ የዜና ቡድን አባላት ላይ ጥቃት ደርሷል። በሌላ በኩል በጋዛ በተፈፀመ የአየር ጥቃት የሶስት አመት ህጻን ህይወት አልፏል። ከዚህም በላይ የእስራኤሉ ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በፍልስጤማውያን እስረኞች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሰው ሰራሽ የማሰብ ችሎታ (AI) ምስል በመልቀቃቸው ትችት ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Lixaa (West Bank) qabamee jiru keessatti, jiraattonni Israa'el namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa yeroo geessisan, garee oduu NBC irrattis haleellaan raawwatameera. Gam biraan immoo, haleellaa qilleensa irraa Gaazaa keessatti raawwatameen daa'imni waggaa sadii lubbuun ishee darbeera. Kana malees, ministirri Israa'el Itamar Ben-Gvir, hidhamtoota Falasxiin kan argisiisu bifa AI (Artificial Intelligence) tiin hojjetame gadi dhiisuun isaanii mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: White House construction on $400m ballroom can go on, says US Supreme Court
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that a $400 million ballroom construction project at the White House may proceed while legal challenges continue. Although a preservation group argues the work lacks necessary congressional approval and historical oversight, the court majority prioritized national security claims and the government's authority. The project is expected to be largely completed within months, effectively bypassing a lower court's previous order to halt construction.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በዋይት ሀውስ እየተካሄደ ያለው የ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ታላቅ የመስተንግዶ አዳራሽ ግንባታ የሕግ ክርክሩ እስኪጠናቀቅ ድረስ እንዲቀጥል ፈቅዷል። የቅርስ ጥበቃ ቡድኖች ግንባታው የኮንግረስ ፈቃድ አላገኘም በማለት ቢከራከሩም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ጉዳዮችን እና የመንግሥትን ስልጣን መነሻ በማድረግ ግንባታው እንዲቀጥል ወስኗል። በዚህ ውሳኔ ምክንያት አብዛኛው የግንባታ ሥራ በጥቂት ወራት ውስጥ የሚጠናቀቅ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ቀደም ሲል በታችኛው ፍርድ ቤት ታግዶ የነበረውን ፕሮጀክት እንደገና እንዲጀመር አድርጎታል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Ameerikaa ijaarsa galma guddaa kan galii doolaara miliyoona 400 waggaa galma Mana Maree (White House) keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru, mormiin seeraa osoo itti fufuu akka itti fufu hayyameera. Gareewwan seenaa eeguu fi tursiisuu, ijaarsi kun hayyama Kongireesii hin qabu jechuun mormaniyyuu, mana murtichi nageenya biyyoolessaa fi aangoo mootummaatti fayyadamuun ijaarsichi akka itti fufu murteesseera. Murtee kanaan, ijaarsi kun ji'oota muraasa keessatti kan xumuramu yoo ta'u, kunis murtee mana murtii gadii kanaan dura ijaarsicha dhaabuuf darbee ture kan haqee dha.

title: Poland opens terror probe into fire at factory supplying Ukraine drones
english: Polish authorities have launched a terrorism investigation following a suspicious fire at a defense factory that produces drone components for Ukraine. Officials are examining whether the incident, which occurred at the WB Electronics plant, was an act of foreign sabotage. This event follows a pattern of suspected Russian-backed interference targeting European nations that provide military support to Kyiv.
amharic: ለዩክሬን የድሮን መለዋወጫዎችን የሚያመርት የፖላንድ ፋብሪካ ላይ በደረሰ የእሳት አደጋ ዙሪያ የፖላንድ ባለስልጣናት የአሸባሪነት ምርመራ ጀምረዋል። በደብሊውቢ ኤሌክትሮኒክስ ፋብሪካ ላይ የደረሰው ይህ የእሳት አደጋ በውጭ ሀገር የስለላ ተቋማት የተፈጸመ የሴረኝነት ተግባር ስለመሆኑ እየተጣራ ነው። ይህ ክስተት ዩክሬንን የሚደግፉ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ላይ በሩሲያ የሚፈጸሙ ናቸው ተብለው ከሚጠረጠሩ የጥፋት ድርጊቶች አንዱ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Poolaand, iddoo meeshaalee xiyyara gargaarsa biyya Yukreeniif oolchu oomishutti ibiddi erga ka’ee booda qorannoo shororkeessummaa jalqabdeetti. Iddoon WB Electronics jedhamu kun sababa ibiddichaan miidhamuu isaa hordofee, gochi kun ergamtoota biyya alaatiin kan raawwatame ta’uu isaa qulqulleessuuf qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira. Gochi kun biyyoota Yukreen gargaaraa jiran irratti garee Ruusiyaatiin raawwatamaa jira jedhamee shakkiin jiru keessaa isa tokko ta’uu isaa ibsameera.

title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
english: Rescue teams in Nepal are using explosives to break through mud-blocked tunnels at a hydropower plant site in a desperate effort to locate hundreds of workers trapped after catastrophic flooding. While international specialists have joined the search, families are growing increasingly frustrated by the slow pace of the operation as the overall national death toll climbs toward 1,000. Workers remain in critical danger as authorities race to supply oxygen into the subterranean structures, hoping to find survivors before the window for rescue closes.
amharic: በኔፓል የሚገኙ የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት በሃይድሮ ፓወር ጣቢያ ዋሻዎች ውስጥ የታሰሩ ሰራተኞችን ለማግኘት ፈንጂዎችን በመጠቀም ተራራውን እየሰነጠቁ ነው። በአለም አቀፍ ባለሙያዎች እየታገዘ ያለው ይህ የፍለጋ ስራ ቢቀጥልም፣ በአገሪቱ የደረሰው የሞት ቁጥር ወደ 1,000 እየተጠጋ በመሆኑ የጠፉ ሰዎች ቤተሰቦች በሂደቱ መዘግየት ከፍተኛ ቅሬታ እያሰሙ ነው። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በዋሻው ውስጥ ኦክሲጅን በማስገባት የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gareen gargaarsaa Nepaal keessatti bal’inaan hidha humna bishaanii (hydropower) keessatti namoota duumansaan makamee hafe baasuuf dhagaa keessa dhuka’aan diiguun barbaacha cimaa geggeessaa jiru. Gareen biyyoota addunyaa irraa dhufan barbaacha kana irratti hirmaatus, lakkoofsi namoota du’anii 1,000 ga’aa waan jiruuf maatiin namoota dhabamanii dafii dhabeessa ta’uu hojii kanaatti gaddaniiru. Ogeeyyiin gargaarsaa balbala dhoqee cufamee jiru keessatti oksijiinii akka gahu gochuun, lubbuun jiraachuun namoota kanaa akka itti fufuuf carraaqqii taasisaa jiru.

title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
english: Celebrity defense attorneys representing US singer D4vd, whose legal name is David Anthony Burke, have stepped down from his murder trial. The 21-year-old musician, who is accused of murdering a 14-year-old girl, will now be represented by a public defender. While prosecutors are prepared to proceed, officials acknowledge that this legal change could potentially delay the upcoming court proceedings.
amharic: የአሜሪካዊው ዘፋኝ ዲፎርድ (D4vd) የህግ ጠበቆች ከነፍስ ግድያ ክሱ መውጣታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በ14 ዓመቷ ወጣት ግድያ የተከሰሰው ዴቪድ አንቶኒ ቡርክ ከዚህ በኋላ በይፋዊ የህዝብ ጠበቃ ይወከላል። አቃቤ ህግ ለፍርድ ሂደቱ ዝግጁ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ የጠበቆች ለውጥ የፍርድ ሂደቱ እንዲዘገይ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ተነግሯል።
oromo: Abukaatonni beekamoon sirbeessaawwan Ameerikaa D4vd jedhamuuf falmaa turan himata ajjeechaa isaa irraa gad-lakkisaniiru. Himatni ajjeechaa dargaggeettii umurii 14 irratti baname irra kan jiru dargaggeessi waggaa 21 kun, gara fuulduraatti abukaatoo mootummaan ramaduun kan itti fufu ta'a. Abbaan alangaa dhaddachaaf qophii ta'uu ibsatus, jijjiiramni abukaatoo kun adeemsa seeraa kan turu ta'uu malu.

title: ‘Nothing is usable’: Nepal residents return to flood-ravaged homes
english: Residents in Nepal's Devighat area are facing immense hardship as they return to homes destroyed by severe flooding. Many are struggling to recover belongings from thick layers of mud and wreckage left behind by the disaster. The death toll from the floods across Nepal and Tibet has surpassed 900, with thousands of people still reported missing.
amharic: በኔፓል ዲቪጋት አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች በከባድ ጎርፍ ለወደሙ ቤቶቻቸው በመመለስ ላይ ሲሆኑ ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ብዙ ሰዎች በጎርፉ ከቤታቸው ውስጥ በገባው ጭቃ እና ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ ንብረቶቻቸውን ለማዳን እየታገሉ ነው። በኔፓል እና በቲቤት በደረሰው በዚህ አደጋ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ900 በላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Namoonni naannoo Deevigaat, Neeppaal jiraatan, lolaa hamaa mana isaanii mancaase booda gara mana isaaniitti deebi'uun miidhaa guddaa keessa jiru. Namoonni hedduun lolaan gara mana isaaniitti gadi dhiise keessaa qabeenya isaanii baafachuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Neeppaal fi Tiibetitti lolaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 900 ol darbeera, akkasumas namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman amma ammaatti eessa akka jiran hin beekamu.

title: Ukrainians mourn community leader killed in Russian strike on Myla
english: The Dmytrivka community is grieving the loss of Taras Didych, a respected leader who died following a Russian missile strike on an ammunition depot in Myla. He was killed while attempting to assist victims of the attack. In total, 38 people lost their lives in this tragic incident.
amharic: የድሚትሪቭካ ማህበረሰብ በሚላ አካባቢ በሚገኝ የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻ ላይ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃት ህይወቱ ያለፈውን ታዋቂ መሪ ታራስ ዲዲች እያዘኑ ነው። ግለሰቡ ጥቃቱ በደረሰበት ወቅት ለተጎጂዎች እርዳታ ለመስጠት ሲሯሯጥ ነበር የሞተው። በአጠቃላይ በዚህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት 38 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል።
oromo: Hawaasni Dmiitiriivka hogganaa kabajamaa Taaraas Diidiich jedhamu kan rukuttaa xiyyaaraa Ruusiyaan magaalaa Miilaa keessatti bakka meeshaa waraanaa irratti dhaqqabsiisteen du'eef gadda irra jiru. Hogganaan kun miidhamtoota gargaaruuf yommuu ariifatu balaa kanaan ajjeeffame. Waliigalaan namoonni 38 gocha suukanneessaa kanaan lubbuun darbeera.

title: What to know: US court hearing held for alleged Lockerbie bombmaker
english: A US court hearing is moving forward regarding Abu Agila Mohammad Mas’ud, a former Libyan intelligence officer accused of building the bomb used in the 1988 Pan Am Flight 103 attack over Lockerbie, Scotland. Although the trial was set to begin recently, a federal judge delayed the proceedings to allow the defense team to review newly discovered evidence. This case is significant as it marks the first time a suspect in this historical tragedy, which claimed 270 lives, has faced trial within the United States.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ1988 በስኮትላንድ በሎከርቢ ላይ የፓን አም በረራ 103ን የጣለውን ቦምብ በማምረት የተጠረጠሩት የቀድሞ የሊቢያ የስለላ ኦፊሰር አቡ አጊላ መሐመድ መስዑድ በዩኤስ የፍርድ ቤት ችሎት ቀርበዋል። የፌዴራል ዳኛው ችሎቱን ለጊዜው ያዘገዩት የመከላከያ ጠበቆች አዲስ የተገኙ መረጃዎችን እንዲመረምሩ ዕድል ለመስጠት ነው። ይህ ክስ ከሰላሳ ዓመታት በፊት 270 ሰዎችን ለቀጠፈው የሽብር ጥቃት በአሜሪካ ምድር የሚካሄድ የመጀመሪያው የፍርድ ሂደት ነው።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Yunaayitid Isteets duraanii ajajaa basaastota Libiyaa kan ta'an Abu Agila Mohaammad Mas'ud, bara 1988 xiyyaarri Paan Aam 103 biyya Iskootland magaalaa Lokarbii gubbaatti akka kuufu bomii hojjetaniiru jedhee himateera. Abbaan seeraa tokko himatamaa kanaan dura erga qabamee booda, ragaalee haaraa argaman sakatta'uuf carraa akka argatan jechuun dhaddacha sana yeroof tureera. Namoonni 270 lubbuun isaanii darbe balaa kanaan, himatamni kun biyya Ameerikaa keessatti harka qabaachuu isaatiin seeraatti dhiyaachuu isaa kan agarsiisu ta'a.

title: Trump approval rating remains at record low, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
english: A recent Reuters/Ipsos survey indicates that President Donald Trump's public approval rating has stayed at its historical low of 33 percent. This decline in popularity is linked to growing concerns over inflation and the ongoing conflict involving Iran. The findings are based on feedback from over 1,000 participants gathered across the United States.
amharic: አዲስ የተካሄደ የሮይተርስ/ኢፕሶስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወዳጅነት በታሪክ ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ የሆነው 33 በመቶ ላይ መሆኑን ነው። ይህ የድጋፍ መቀነስ ከኢኮኖሚ ግሽበት እና ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዘ ካለው ግጭት ጋር የተያያዘ ነው። ጥናቱ የተካሄደው በመላው አሜሪካ ከሚገኙ ከ1,000 በላይ ሰዎች አስተያየት በመሰብሰብ ነው።
oromo: Qorannoon dhiheenya Reuters/Ipsos gaggeesse akka argisiisutti, fudhatamummaan pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp gara 33%tti gadi bu'ee jira. Hir'inni deggersa kanaa rakkoo gatii gurguddaa dabaluu fi waldhabdee biyyattii Iran wajjin jiruun kan wal qabatu dha. Ragaan kun namoota Ameerikaa keessa jiraatan 1,000 ol ta'an irraa kan walitti qabame dha.

title: Saudi-backed LIV Golf preparing for bankruptcy filing
english: The Saudi-funded LIV Golf tour is preparing to file for bankruptcy as the kingdom withdraws its financial support following massive losses. The organization is currently offering players minimal settlement payouts while attempting to restructure into a new version of the league. This move is part of a broader trend of Saudi Arabia scaling back major projects due to economic pressures and the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚደገፈው የሊቭ ጎልፍ ውድድር ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ በማጋጠሙ ምክንያት ኪሳራውን ለፍርድ ቤት ለማወጅ እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ድርጅቱ ለተጫዋቾች የገባውን የገንዘብ ቃል ኪዳን መፈጸም ባለመቻሉ አነስተኛ ክፍያዎችን እያቀረበ ሲሆን በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ውድድሩን በአዲስ መልክ ለማደራጀት ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በኢኮኖሚ ግፊት እና በክልሉ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ዋና ዋና ፕሮጀክቶቿን ከመቀነሷ ጋር ተያይዞ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Sagantaan tapha golfii LIV Golf kan Saudii Arabaatiin deeggaramu, kasaaraa guddaa erga mudatee booda bankirootii ta'uuf qophii gochaa jira. Dhaabbatichi taphattootaaf kakuu kaffaltii durii raawwachuu waan dadhabeef, amma kaffaltii xiqqoo qofa dhiheessuun amala haaraatti of jijjiiruuf yaalaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kunis biyyattii keessatti dhiibbaa diinagdee fi waldhabdee naannoo sanaa irraa kan ka'e, pirojektoota gurguddoo hir'isuu ishee kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump's vow to escalate on Iran rings hollow amid warnings from top US generals
english: President Trump has threatened to retaliate aggressively against Iran following attacks on a U.S. base in Jordan. However, top military leaders have cautioned that a sustained large-scale conflict would hinder the ability of the United States to address other global security threats. Tensions have caused international oil prices to rise as the prospect of further escalation remains a significant concern.

oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Yordaanos keessatti argamu irratti erga haleellaan raawwatamee booda, Iraan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf doorsisaniiru. Haata'u malee, ajootonni olaanoon waraana Ameerikaa, waraanni bal'aan dheeraa yoo itti fufe dandeettii Ameerikaan rakkoolee nageenyaa biroo addunyaa irratti qabdu akka laaffisu akeekkachiisaniiru. Gidduu kana rakkoon kun caalaatti hammaata soda jedhuun gatiin boba'aa addunyaa dabalee argama.

title: Oil prices jump amid resumption of US-Iran clashes
english: Global oil prices increased by over 2.5% following renewed military conflict between the United States and Iran. Tensions escalated after a US attack on Larak Island led to Iranian retaliation and the subsequent closure of the critical Strait of Hormuz. While crude prices reached $90.34 per barrel, they remain below the peak costs observed earlier this year.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በተከሰተው አዲስ ወታደራዊ ግጭት ምክንያት የአለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከ2.5 በመቶ በላይ ጨምሯል። በአሜሪካ የላራክ ደሴት ላይ የተፈፀመውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ኢራን ምላሽ የሰጠች ሲሆን፣ በዚህም ምክንያት ወሳኙ የሆርሙዝ የባህር መስመር ተዘግቷል። ምንም እንኳን የድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ዋጋ በአንድ በርሜል ወደ 90.34 ዶላር ቢደርስም፣ ይህ ዋጋ ከዚህ ቀደም በዓመቱ ከነበረው ከፍተኛ የዋጋ ንረት አሁንም ዝቅተኛ ነው።
oromo: Giddu galeessa lola mootummaa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti deebi'ee dhohe hordofee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa dhibbeentaa 2.5 ol dabaleera. Ameerikaan odola Laarak haleeluushee fi Iraan deebii kennuushii hordofee, daandiin markabaa Hormuz cufameera. Gatiin boba'aa barmeela tokkoon gara doolaara 90.34 kan ga'e ta'us, gatiin kun waguma kana keessa bakka ol aanaa ga'ee ture irra kan gadi aane dha.

title: Trump's vow to escalate on Iran rings hollow amid warnings from top US generals
english: President Trump has promised a significant retaliation against Iran following missile strikes on a US base in Jordan, despite warnings from top military officials that a major, prolonged war is unsustainable. Senior generals have cautioned that the current military deployments, which shift resources away from other global regions, could severely limit the country's defense capabilities elsewhere. Consequently, despite the administration's aggressive rhetoric and rising oil prices, the military leadership remains deeply concerned about the long-term impact of further escalation.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ኢራን ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ቃል ገብተዋል። ሆኖም ከፍተኛ የጦር መሪዎች እንደገለጹት፣ ኢራን ጋር የሚደረግ ረጅም እና ሰፊ ጦርነት የአሜሪካን አቅም የሚጎዳ በመሆኑ ዘላቂነት እንደሌለው አስጠንቅቀዋል። አሁን ያለው የወታደራዊ ሀብት ዝውውር ለሌሎች የአለም ክፍሎች ያለውን የደህንነት ስጋት እንደሚጨምር በመግለጽ፣ አስተዳደሩ ከሚያደርገው የዛቻ ንግግር በተቃራኒ ወታደራዊ አመራሩ የጦርነቱን መስፋፋት እንደማይደግፉ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Prezidaant tiraamp weerara buufata waraana Ameerika kan Yordaanos keessatti raawwatame hordofee Iran irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatan waadaa galan. Qondaalonni kunneen mootummaan ibsa cimaa kennus, guddinni waraanaa kun naannolee biroo irratti qophii waraana Ameerikaa akka laaffisu yaaddoo qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
english: A 43-year-old Swiss man has been taken into custody following a fatal shooting at a techno dance party in the town of Aarau. The attack resulted in the death of a 22-year-old Italian woman and left five other attendees with injuries. Authorities conducted a day-long search and currently believe the suspect acted independently while they continue to investigate his motives.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ አራው ከተማ በተካሄደ የቴክኖ ሙዚቃ ድግስ ላይ በተፈጸመ ተኩስ አንድ የ43 ዓመት ስዊዘርላንዳዊ ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። በዚሁ ጥቃት የ22 ዓመቷ ጣሊያናዊት ሴት ህይወት ሲያልፍ፣ ሌሎች አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ለቀናት ያህል ባካሄደው ፍለጋ ተጠርጣሪውን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱን የፈጸመው ብቻውን እንደሆነ እና የምርመራ ሂደቱ መቀጠሉን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Magala Aarau kan jedhamtu keessatti namni lammii Siwiizerlaandi waggaa 43 tokko guyyaa har'aa to'annoo jala ooleera. Namichi kun qophii muzikii 'techno' irratti dhukaasa banuun dubartii lammii Xaaliyaanii waggaa 22 taate ajjeeseera, namoonni shan biroo immoo madaa'aniiru. Poolisiin sa'aatii 24 guutuu hordoffii godheen booda namicha qabachuu isaa fi namichi kun kophaa isaa akka raawwate shakkamaa akka jiru ibseera.

title: South African airline defends low-altitude aerial stunt over packed stadium
english: Airlink is defending a recent low-altitude flyover where two of its jets passed extremely close to a packed rugby stadium in Cape Town before a match between South Africa and New Zealand. While some critics labeled the maneuver as reckless, the airline insisted the stunt was carefully planned and executed by highly skilled pilots in accordance with aviation safety approvals. Many spectators and officials praised the display as a demonstration of expert flying and national pride.
amharic: ኤርሊንክ በተባለው አየር መንገድ የሁለት አውሮፕላኖቹ በኬፕታውን ስታዲየም ላይ በዝቅተኛ ከፍታ መብረር ትክክል እንደነበር በመግለጽ ተከላክሏል። በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በኒውዚላንድ የራግቢ ጨዋታ መክፈቻ ላይ የተደረገው ይህ ድርጊት አደገኛ ነው የሚል ትችት ቢሰነዘርበትም፣ አየር መንገዱ የበረራው እቅድ በባለሙያዎች የተጠና እና አስፈላጊውን የደህንነት ፈቃድ ያገኘ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። በርካታ ታዳሚዎችና የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ግን የበረራውን ትክክለኛነት በማድነቅ ለሀገራዊ ኩራት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
